description: Entur open data provides Norway's national public-transport registry, collecting scheduled service information from 60 operators. The provider is Entur. Geographical and temporal coverage: The page states 21000 daily departures on 3000 routes, with a notice that documentation is moving to developer.entur.no. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The old developer portal is being retired. The displayed scale is a provider statement, not a fresh census of the live registry. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
